approach.title: From Sequence, to Clearer Scientific Vision
approach.subtitle: Three core pillars of our open scientific framework.
approach.card1_desc: Trace every candidate peptide back to peer-reviewed literature, primary accession records, and verified physical coordinates.
approach.card2_desc: Calculate standard biophysical descriptors using transparent algorithms without black-box transformations.
approach.card3_desc: Decouple activity predictions from safety profiles and present epistemic limitations with unvarnished honesty.

evidence_tiers.title: Not All Evidence Has the Same Epistemic Weight
evidence_tiers.subtitle: A transparent four-level evidence categorization.
evidence_tiers.tier1_desc: Direct laboratory observations documented in peer-reviewed scientific articles with verifiable assay conditions.
evidence_tiers.tier2_desc: Entries from trusted international repositories (UniProt, PDB, NCBI) with established biological provenance.
evidence_tiers.tier3_desc: In silico estimates from validated algorithms; serves as an exploratory hypothesis, not wet-lab confirmation.
evidence_tiers.tier4_desc: Unassayed properties, missing cytotoxicity profiles, and unresolved mechanism gaps marked for future laboratory research.
